intro.text: Varsity Kotha. Your class routine and your campus voice, in one app.

scene-1.text: Open it in the morning, and see your next class, room and teacher.

scene-2.text: One routine for your whole section, always up to date.

scene-3.text: Class cancelled, or moved to another day? You’ll be the first to know.

scene-4.text: Reminders for tests and deadlines, the evening before.

scene-5.text: Raise any campus problem, without giving your name.

scene-6.text: And get answers straight from your university.

scene-8.text: Bus times, your CGPA… it’s all here.

outro.text: Varsity Kotha! Get it free, on Google Play.
